mapper.insert: insert into SV01 (seq, title, text, userid, regdate, multiselect) values (SEQ_SV01.NEXTVAL, #{title}, #{text}, #{userid}, #{regdate}, #{multiselect})
mapper.select: select S1.seq as seq, S1.title as title, S1.text as text, S1.userid as userid, S1.regdate as regdate, S1.hit as hit, S1.good as good, S1.multiselect as multiselect, SL1.goodlog as goodlog, SL1.hatelog as hatelog, (select count(*) as votedYn from SV03 S3 where S1.seq = S3.seq and userid = #{userid} ) as votedYn from SV01 S1 left outer join( select * from SVG1 where seq = #{seq} and sessionid = #{userid} ) SL1 on (S1.seq = SL1.seq) where S1.seq = #{seq}
select S1.seq as seq, S1.userid as userid from SV01 S1 where S1.seq = #{seq}

SELECT /*+ LEADING(S1 R V) USE_NL(R) USE_NL(V) */ S1.seq, S1.title, S1.text, S1.userid, S1.regdate, S1.hit, S1.good, NVL(R.reply, 0) AS reply, NVL(V.votedCnt, 0) AS votedCnt, S1.totCnt FROM ( SELECT S.*, CNT.totCnt FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT /*+ INDEX_DESC(SV01 PK_SV01) */ ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY seq DESC) AS rn, seq, title, text, userid, regdate, hit, good FROM SV01 ) WHERE rn > #{startRownum} AND rn <= #{endRownum} ) S, (SELECT /*+ INDEX_FFS(SV01 PK_SV01) */ COUNT(*) AS totCnt FROM SV01) CNT ) S1 LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT /*+ INDEX(SV04 IDX_SV04_1) */ seq01, COUNT(*) AS reply FROM SV04 WHERE parents = 0 GROUP BY seq01 ) R ON S1.seq = R.seq01 LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT /*+ INDEX(SV03 PK_SV03) */ seq, COUNT(*) AS votedCnt FROM SV03 GROUP BY seq ) V ON S1.seq = V.seq

SELECT /*+ LEADING(T R) USE_NL(R) */ T.seq, T.title, T.text, T.userid, T.regdate, T.hit, T.good, NVL(R.reply, 0) AS reply FROM ( SELECT /*+ INDEX_DESC(SV01 idx_SV01_2) */ seq, title, text, userid, regdate, hit, good FROM SV01 WHERE 1 = 1
AND userid LIKE #{userid} || '%'
AND title LIKE #{title} || '%'
ORDER BY regdate DESC ) T LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT seq01, COUNT(*) AS reply FROM SV04 WHERE parents = 0 GROUP BY seq01 ) R ON T.seq = R.seq01
mapper.update: merge into SVG1 S1 using dual on (S1.seq = #{seq} and S1.sessionid = #{sessionid}) when matched then update set S1.datelog = #{datelog}, S1.goodlog = 'Y' when not matched then insert (S1.seq, S1.sessionid, S1.datelog, S1.goodlog ) values(#{seq}, #{sessionid}, #{datelog} , 'Y')

merge into SVG1 S1 using dual on (S1.seq = #{seq} and S1.sessionid = #{sessionid}) when matched then update set S1.datelog = #{datelog}, S1.hatelog = 'Y' when not matched then insert (S1.seq, S1.sessionid, S1.datelog, S1.hatelog ) values(#{seq}, #{sessionid}, #{datelog} , 'Y')
